title: Finch vs Habitica: Which Habit App Is Right for You? (2026)
caption: Video: Finch vs Habitica in five rounds, plus a bonus round (2:46)
description: Finch or Habitica? Finch for gentle self-care with no penalty for a bad day, Habitica for habits and to-dos that play like a game with real stakes. Five rounds: missing a day, habits and to-dos, mood, rewards, and friends and accountability.
